offset_convention: track_b(frame_a + lag_ab) corresponds to track_a(frame_a); corrected_frame = source_frame - offset_camera; offset_1 = 0
graph_rule: union of four nearest camera-center neighbors per camera with >=100 commonly visible frozen training-map points; no camera-ID adjacency
dynamic_support: seed only inside nearest fitting semantic/motion mask; require sustained track motion; no static-background timing evidence
fit_gate: distinct optimum, track bootstrap halfwidth <=0.25 frame, connected accepted graph with cycles covering every camera and cycle residual <=0.25 frame
reserved_gate: freeze fitting graph, offsets, track/association rules before selection; selection/final dynamic tracks use their own windows, minimum length 30, seeds at start and start+10; verify each frozen edge within +/-1 frame and temporal-half agreement <=0.25; no changing graph or rules using final results
final_validation: separate timing winner and one-use timing-validation-consumed.json; never consume or reset Plan 006 static validation
rationale: Use strict descriptor and forward/backward checks, 12 spatially seeded moving tracks and 15 samples per track to reject unsupported timing; 0.05px gap distinguishes a flat search curve. All criteria frozen before track extraction; failures retain diagnostics and block downstream use.
